Fluent English, with the ability to communicate clearly across international project teams and with external stakeholders. Strong analytical approach and the ability to develop structured, practical solutions to complex technical challenges. Preferred Working knowledge of BIM methodologies and their application in substation design projects. Familiarity with MS Office and Windows in a project engineering environment. In Katowice, you will be part of an international team that collaborates across borders and disciplines, tackling infrastructure challenges that have real-world consequences for how energy is generated, transmitted, and used. GE Vernova employees rise to the challenge of building a world that works. We provide varied, competitive benefits to help support our workforce — designed to reward strong performance and help you manage your personal and family needs. A healthy, balanced lifestyle means different things to different people, and we've created programs that support the way you live and work today. We also invest in your continued on-the-job learning and development, providing a clear path for career growth. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No This is a remote position
